headline: Public hearings on a fall carnival at 100 Main Street and an auto repair shop at 102 Esten Avenue.
summary: The meeting covers a public hearing on a fall carnival at 100 Main Street from October 8 to 12, 2026, benefiting the Pawtucket Soup Kitchen. It also covers a postponed public hearing on a new auto repair shop at 102 Esten Avenue, plus other license petitions.
items: Pigeon loft license renewal for Petros Zervas, 27 Harrison St. (LIC#PGN-24-1)
New first class victualling house license for The Bluejay Café (The Bluejay Café LLC), 250 Main Street (LIC#VIC-26-21)

Public hearing and petition for a fall carnival by Rockwell Amusement and Promotions, Inc., at 100 Main Street, October 8 to 12, 2026 (LIC#EVT-26-83). Charity: Pawtucket Soup Kitchen, located at 150 Walcott Street.
Postponed public hearing and petition for a new auto repair shop, Correia Auto Repair (Professional Auto Repair LLC), 102 Esten Avenue (LIC#AUT-26-8). Previously Woodlawn Village.

Petition by CoLab Studio Theatre Inc. for a fundraiser, cabaret singing event, and beer and wine sales at 560 Mineral Spring Avenue, Unit 1-103, on October 16 and 17, 2026, 7:00 to 9:00 p.m. (LIC#EVT-26-85)
location: Pawtucket Municipal Annex, 100 Freight Street, 2nd Floor – Temporary Council Chambers (enter parking lot at 75 Sabin Street)
